note: Every entry was opened and read with the page reader on 2026-11-12. 'scope' records exactly what was observed. A reachable page is not a factual or rights certification.

sources.title: 2026 NFL League Standings — regular season
sources.scope: Both result chunks read. All 32 club rows transcribed for W, L, T, PCT, PF, PA, NET PTS. Division/conference, home/road, streak and clinch columns were not transcribed because the rendered table has no header row in the capture (flag DF-04).

sources.title: 2026 NFL Division Standings
sources.scope: Both chunks read. Confirms each club's division grouping (AFC East/North/South/West, NFC East/North/South/West) and that the same seven numeric fields repeat identically. Used only for division assignment, cross-checked against the league table.

sources.title: 2026 NFL offense points stats by Team
sources.scope: Full 32-row table read. The captured table is unlabeled. Only ATT, CMP, PCT, AVG, YDS were transcribed, and only after the build verified round(CMP/ATT*100,1)==PCT and round(YDS/ATT,1)==AVG on every row. TD/INT/longest and five further columns were not identified and are not filled (flag DF-03).

sources.title: Official Latest NFL Injury Report — Week 10 of the 2026 season
sources.scope: All seven result chunks read. 278 player rows across 26 clubs transcribed with the four rendered fields (Position, Injuries, Practice Status, Game Status); two clubs rendered 'No Injuries Reported'. Four clubs were on bye and are absent. This is one page state, not a live feed.

sources.title: 2026 NFL Schedule — Week 10
sources.scope: All three chunks read. Confirmed the Week 10 fixture list used for the availability table (14 games), kickoff times, and the four clubs on bye (CHI, DEN, PHI, TB). Start times are the site's displayed local-to-user times and are not re-expressed.

sources.title: NFL Tiebreaking Procedures
sources.scope: Read. Used only to describe why division rank cannot be computed from win-loss record alone: head-to-head, division, common-games and strength-of-victory steps precede points. This is why DF-05 leaves tie-break-dependent fields blank.

sources.title: NFL.com Terms and Conditions (updated 16 May 2024)
sources.scope: Read sections 1.1–1.3, 7–11. §1.3 limits use to individual non-commercial informational purposes and prohibits systematic retrieval or compilation without prior written consent. §11(f) prohibits using the Services to harvest information for a commercial purpose. No gambling permission is granted and none is inferred here.

sources.title: NFL Football Operations
sources.scope: Read. Confirmed the 2026 Rulebook hub and the league calendar exist. A guessed injury-report-policy URL under this host returned an empty capture, so no policy paragraph is attributed to it (flag DF-08).
